+def _get_fill_value(var, fill_value):
+    """Get the appropriate fill value for a variable."""
+    if fill_value is dtypes.NA:
+        # Use NaN for floating point, or the fill_value for other types
+        if np.issubdtype(var.dtype, np.floating):
+            return np.nan
+        else:
+            return fill_value
+    return fill_value
+
+
+def _reindex_and_align_datasets(datasets, dim, join, fill_value):
+    """
+    Reindex and align datasets to have the same variables.
+    
+    When join='outer', missing variables are filled with fill_value.
+    """
+    from .dataset import Dataset
+    
+    if join != 'outer':
+        return datasets
+    
+    # Collect all variables from all datasets
+    all_vars = set()
+    all_dims = {}
+    for ds in datasets:
+        all_vars.update(ds.data_vars)
+        all_vars.update(ds.coords)
+        all_dims.update(ds.dims)
+    
+    # For each dataset, add missing variables
+    new_datasets = []
+    for ds in datasets:
+        missing_vars = all_vars - set(ds.variables)
+        if missing_vars:
+            # Create placeholder variables for missing ones
+            new_vars = dict(ds.variables)
+            for var_name in missing_vars:
+                # Find the variable in another dataset to get its dimensions
+                var_dims = None
+                var_dtype = None
+                for other_ds in datasets:
+                    if var_name in other_ds.variables:
+                        other_var = other_ds.variables[var_name]
+                        var_dims = other_var.dims
+                        var_dtype = other_var.dtype
+                        break
+                
+                if var_dims is not None:
+                    # Create a placeholder variable with the right shape
+                    shape = tuple(all_dims.get(d, 1) for d in var_dims)
+                    fill_val = _get_fill_value(other_var, fill_value)
+                    data = np.full(shape, fill_val, dtype=var_dtype)
+                    new_vars[var_name] = Variable(var_dims, data)
+            
+            ds = Dataset(new_vars, coords=ds.coords, attrs=ds.attrs)
+        new_datasets.append(ds)
+    
+    return new_datasets
+
